name: Cala Macarelleta
description: Macarella's smaller, more intimate sister, separated by a rocky isthmus; intense turquoise water and a partly naturist atmosphere. More secluded and photogenic, with no facilities of its own.

highlights: Macarella's intimate sister, beyond a rocky isthmus
intense turquoise and a secluded feel (partly naturist)
reached on foot from Macarella; no services at all, bring your own

imageAlt: Cala Macarelleta: white sand, turquoise water and pines above the cliff

practicalInfo.aparcamiento: It has no car park of its own: you walk over from Macarella along a short path up the cliff. That means it inherits the restriction: from 1 June to 30 September you must reach Macarella by bus, authorised taxi, bicycle or on foot. The bus leaves Ciutadella between 8.25am and 8.20pm; €8.50 return when booked online (half price with the Consell travel card).
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: It is small and fills up before Macarella does, so the first bus of the day (8.25am) is the difference between having it to yourself and sharing it with a crowd. May, June and September are clearly better than August.
